title: streamline-sdk-dependency-graph-and-remove-legacy-promise-shims
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Reduce maintenance cost and runtime risk by consolidating SDK dependency versions across Python, JS, and Go clients, removing legacy promise/callback shims in the JS client, and cleaning up deprecated API surface. This ticket coordinates library bumps, compatibility shims, migration docs, CI changes, and rollout strategy. Scope: (1) Bump supported transitive deps across SDKs (httpx, aiohttp, node-fetch -> undici, protobuf, gogo/protobuf replacements), (2) Remove legacy promise/callback wrappers in JS client and expose unified async/await + synchronous helper where possible, (3) Run full integration matrix against hosted API and dedicated runtime to detect regressions, (4) Publish migration guides and codemods, (5) Prepare canary and gradual rollout plan with feature flags, (6) Update packaging and release tooling (build matrices, pinned GH actions). Out of scope: Large API surface changes to server API. Deprecation windows will be communicated in patch/major cadence.

Unit and integration tests pass in canary lab for hosted and dedicated runtimes

Customer SDK pinning: provide pinned vX.Y.Z customers and backports for 8 weeks during rollout
